issues_found.description: ORD-03: sweepStalledCorrelations predicate is `p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq` (missing + 1), so a slow-but-present correlation whose lowest PENDING sequence equals applied_seq+1 is wrongly dead-lettered. Requirement AC5 requires the predecessor to be ABSENT. TC-ORD-03-AC5-non-stalled-not-swept fails. Fix: `p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq + 1`.

DDL-04 AC5: runBackfill executes `if (rows_updated == 0) break;` BEFORE the stall check, so the ten-consecutive-zero-progress stall policy is unreachable; a stuck backfill terminates with stalled=false/status=applied instead of escalating. TC-DDL-04-AC5-stall-escalation fails. The zero-row break must only fire when rows_remaining==0; zero-progress with rows_remaining>0 must count toward the stall threshold.

VLD-04: runSemanticGate's finding-producing path corrupts heap memory - persistVerdict writes a garbage compiler_version into process_definitions whenever validateDefinition returns findings (clean passes write the correct constant; verified), and TC-VLD-04-AC3-stale-verdict-reruns / TC-VLD-04-AC4-timeout segfault. Root cause is in the validateDefinition finding path (VLD-01/02/03 pipeline) or BACKEND-DEV's gate wiring - needs ISSUE-FIXER root-cause.

Event appends (EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED, EXECUTION_EFFECT_APPLIED, DEFINITION_VALIDATED/FAILED) originally targeted public.events, which GBL-112 permanently dropped (events are per-tenant). They failed with 42P01, then 42P10 on ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) because the partitioned events table has no unique on idempotency_key. Fixed to the canonical plat_event_idempotency sidecar + unqualified `events` pattern in gate.zig/consumer.zig/validation/gate.zig. Confirmed by tests. (This fix is applied; recorded for traceability.)

BACKEND-DEV's consumer.zig applyCompletion and backfill.zig mapBatchError used `_ = err` in catch blocks, which Zig 0.16 rejects as 'error set is discarded' - the ordering/backfill integration tests could not compile until fixed (dropped the unused error capture).

gate.zig called OutboxGateConfig.deriveLowWater as an instance method (`config.deriveLowWater(cap)`); the function has no self parameter and only compiled when a unit test never invoked evaluateAndDecide. Fixed to the type-qualified call.

recordBatchProgress hardcodes backfill_batch_size=5000 in plat_migration_state (the live adaptive value is only in BackfillResult.final_batch_size) and never transitions the row status from 'running' to 'applied'/'failed' at loop end (design's terminal write is missing).
BACKEND-DEV's six changed .zig files were not zig fmt-formatted and blocked `zig build check`; formatted them (whitespace-only) to unblock the gate.

canonical event_store.Store.appendPlatform also uses SET LOCAL search_path TO public + INSERT INTO events; since GBL-112 dropped public.events this is a latent defect in the shipped event-store path too - out of scope for this batch but flagged for awareness.
